newsitem.title: UK: No plans to sell Sky stake - Granada.
newsitem.headline: No plans to sell Sky stake - Granada.

text.p: Gerry Robinson, chairman of British leisure and media group Granada Plc, said on Wednesday that his company had no plans to sell its 10.8 percent stake in satellite broadcaster British Sky Broadcasting Plc.
"We have not changed our stance on BSkyB," he told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
"It's a very strong relationship which works," added Robinson, who is also chairman of BSkyB.
The Granada chairman noted that the firm's BSkyB stake had tripled in value over what he called "the last couple of years", adding, "In my view, Sky has got a long way to go."
Robinson's comments followed renewed stock market speculation that Granada may seek to sell its holding.
